title: Heart Disease Classification
text:
This project develops and internally validates a classification model for identifying the presence of heart disease using routinely collected demographic, clinical, and exercise-related variables.
The analysis is conducted in R and reported using Quarto to ensure that the complete workflow is transparent and reproducible.
